Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Consultanță și servicii de afaceri și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
20 years on the Romanian IT market and still growing.
 Part of the HN Services Group, with offices in France, Spain, Portugal, and Luxembourg, HN Services Romania is about building real careers, not just filling roles.
 What you’ll find here:
 • Digital transformation projects with real impact
 • A wide range of technical roles across modern and legacy technologies (yes, COBOL is still very much alive)
 • Exposure to diverse industries and international envi ronments
 • Continuous growth through our in-house software development training center (HN Training Institute)
 💡We are currently looking for experienced professionals to deliver high-quality, stable, and resilient software solutions.
 About the role: 
 The Data Analysts extracts, prepares and structure the data required for the manual labeling campaigns to run in order to maintain the AI-based categorization models used throughout Europe (France, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Italy & Belgium).
 The role applies analyzing the data provided by the countries, ensuirng the dat set quality, creating the sample used for the manual labeling campaign, performing the quality audit and preparing the results for the data analyst to update or not the AI-based categorization engine.
 Main responsibilities: 
Review transactions and ensure data quality is satisfying.
Structure the sample set according to the business rules agreed with the central data team
Work with campaign files and perfom quality audits ensuring labeling decisions are consistent across the assigned data population.
Prepare results to be shared with local data scientist as well as other members of the data community across Europe
Follow applicable procedures, methods, confidentiality requirements, and quality standards.
Communicate clearly with the team data anlysts, data scientist or business representative regarding exceptions and uncertainties.
Escalate suspected fraud indicators, system issues, data-quality concerns, or business-rule inconsistencies through the agreed channels.
Contribute to progress tracking and operational reporting by providing accurate status information on assigned batches.
Support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement of working instructions and labeling guidelines.
 What we are looking for: 
Proven experience in Data Management
Good Excel skills and VBA, basic knowledge of Python; Power BI knowledge is a plus
Ability to apply detailed rules consistently while handling repetitive and high-volume activities.
Good analytical judgment and confidence to escalate uncertain cases.
Good written communication, teamwork and stakeholder collaboration skills.
High level of reliability, flexibility, delivery focus and attention to detail.
Fluency in English – another European language is a plus
 Only eligible candidates will be contacted for further information and start of the recruitment process.
